description: This file defines the DefaultConnectionLimitManager class, which enforces a limit on concurrent connections within the Eclipse Hono service framework. It manages connection limits either from configuration or based on a defined strategy, including auto-configuration logic.

classes.name: DefaultConnectionLimitManager
classes.description: Manages the connection limit based on a strategy and configuration, and checks whether the limit is exceeded.

methods.name: DefaultConnectionLimitManager
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the connection limit manager with a strategy, current connections supplier, and optional configuration.

methods.name: isLimitExceeded
methods.description: Checks if the current number of connections exceeds the configured limit.
